note: Invasive aspergillosis is a form of aspergillosis.

note: Exact match.
Lidocaine labels cover ocular surface anesthesia and minor pain; pemphigoid is never mentioned.

quote: PAH associated with congenital heart disease with repaired shunts (10%)
note: Indicated for PAH; heart disease appears only as the background etiology of the study population.

quote: for the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and lymphoblastic lymphoma (LBL)

quote: prevention and treatment of hyperuricaemia in adult patients undergoing chemotherapy for haematologic malignancies at intermediate to high risk of Tumor Lysis Syndrome (TLS)

quote: indicated for intralesional use in alopecia areata, discoid lupus erythematosus, keloids

quote: Sorafenib tablets are indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

quote: Alfuzosin hydrochloride extended-release tablets, USP are not indicated for the treatment of hypertension.

note: Exact match (EMA).

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
note: NSCLC is a form of lung cancer, a close parent. A durvalumab combination regimen, not a fixed-dose combination.
